name: Alvin Kapoor
life: “I still remember picking celery strings off a school pudding spoon.” People around Breakwater Way know Alvin by a small Monday habit. Alvin stops on the landward side of the cycle track to watch the first boats turn for home.
voice: I hate celery and always dug it out. Tonight the cook asked me to choose tomorrow's base.
appearance: Alvin is easy to recognize by a loose dark braid and two dimples that appear only with a full smile. Usually dressed in a faded indigo overshirt with a pen clipped inside the neckline, Alvin squares up pieces of paper while thinking when listening.
personality: Alvin listens for the familiar version of a story and then for the one detail that changes it. Friends bring problems here when they want to be heard twice.
agenda: To choose a different base for tomorrow's pot.
family: Percy Wade is Alvin’s half-sibling. Alvin leaves the first voice message. Percy calls back when there is finally a little privacy. In their family a missed ring can mean a bus, a customer, a sleeping child or a bad hour. Neither treats it as an answer in itself. Asked about *The free fringe*, Percy says, “I want the free slot moved to after school once a week so the kid minding his sister gets a turn.”
connections: Alex Scott. The ingredients record gives the celery-hater a real say in tomorrow's batch.

reactions.situation: A driver splashes a market worker and tries to laugh it off
